casinos.name: The Bellagio
casinos.description: World-famous luxury resort with iconic fountain shows and upscale amenities.
casinos.details: Located on the Las Vegas Strip, The Bellagio is renowned for its elegance and sophistication. Features include a conservatory, fine art gallery, and world-class dining experiences.

casinos.name: Marina Bay Sands
casinos.description: Architectural marvel with the world's largest rooftop infinity pool and panoramic views.
casinos.details: This integrated resort features a 2,561-room hotel, a 1.3 million sq. ft convention center, a mall, museum, two theaters, restaurants, and the world's largest atrium casino with 500 tables and 1,600 slot machines.

casinos.name: Monte Carlo Casino
casinos.description: Historic 19th-century casino offering European elegance and sophistication.
casinos.details: Established in 1863, this Belle Époque architectural masterpiece houses Europe's most prestigious casino. It features ornate gaming rooms with frescoes, sculptures, and gold decorations.

casinos.name: Wynn Las Vegas
casinos.description: Luxury resort featuring award-winning restaurants and a spectacular lake show.
casinos.details: This Forbes Five-Star resort offers spacious rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows, signature restaurants, exciting entertainment, and a breathtaking three-acre lake with a choreographed water feature.

casinos.name: Caesars Palace
casinos.description: Iconic Roman-themed resort with celebrity chef restaurants and opulent gaming areas.
casinos.details: A legendary Las Vegas resort inspired by the Roman Empire. Features include the Colosseum performance venue, Garden of the Gods Pool Oasis, and Forum Shops luxury retail space.

casinos.name: Crown Melbourne
casinos.description: Australia's premier integrated resort with world-class gaming, dining, and entertainment.
casinos.details: Spanning the equivalent of two city blocks along the Yarra River, Crown Melbourne features three hotels, signature restaurants, luxury shopping, and one of the largest gaming floors in the Southern Hemisphere.
